text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Oman appointed BP Chemicals, a unit of British Petroleum, as its partner in a $900 million petrochemical complex to produce 450,000 tonnes a year of ethylene and polyethylene. Oman's minister of trade and industry said 40 percent of the shares will be offered to the public, while BP will take 40 to 49 percent and the rest will go to the state-run Oman Oil Company.
- Three Bahraini men arrested for an arson attack on a house in October.
- Bahrain International Bank announces a 13.5 increase in its net profit to $11.8 million in the first nine months of 1996.
